parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.summary: List active templates for the issue creation picker (REST v2.0)
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of active coordination issue templates suitable for the issue creation
picker UI. Templates are sorted by abbreviation ascending.

Response includes a `recent` array of up to 5 templates recently used by the current user
(based on the most recent coordination issues they created with a template).

Use the `search` parameter to filter templates by abbreviation or title (case-insensitive partial match).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match against template `abbreviation` or `title` (from `issue_details`).

200.description: OK — paginated active templates plus recently used templates

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

items.description:
Streamlined template representation for the issue creation picker.
Default view returns id, abbreviation, title, is_active, and category.
Detail view adds a `fields` array with enriched label/value pairs.

title.description: Title from the template's `issue_details` (may be null if not set).

is_active.description: Whether the template is active. Picker only returns active templates.

category.description: Template category (from `TemplateCategoryBlueprint`). Null if no category assigned.

project_id.description: Project ID if project-scoped; null for company-level categories.

scope.description: Whether the category is company-level or project-level.

recent.description: Up to 5 recently used templates by the current user (id + abbreviation only).

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Procore-Company-Id': "SOME_STRING_VALUE" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/coordination_issues/templates/picker?search=MEP&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

get.summary: Show template detail for the issue creation picker (REST v2.0)
get.description:
Returns a single active template with enriched issue details. The `fields` array contains
label/value pairs for all non-title, non-custom-field keys in `issue_details`, with values
resolved to display names (e.g., location name instead of location ID).

Used to preview template defaults before creating a coordination issue.

200.description: OK — template with enriched detail fields
